# Lade Stack — https://ladestack.in
# AI-crawler friendly index for ladestack.in

> Lade Stack is a free, privacy-first AI developer tools ecosystem founded by Girish Lade.
> In-browser code inspection, visual API testing, PDF utilities, image optimization, and technical tutorials.
> Contact: admin@ladestack.in

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://ladestack.in/): Free AI developer platform & coding utilities
- [Flagship Products](https://ladestack.in/products): Production-grade AI developer tools suite
- [CodeEnhance AI](https://ladestack.in/ai-code-viewer-ai): Real-time frontend code inspection, linter, and live preview sandbox
- [Apps Gallery](https://ladestack.in/apps): Free browser-based developer utilities collection
- [Documentation](https://ladestack.in/docs): Step-by-step developer guides, API specifications, Git export, and Vercel deployment checklists
- [Engineering Blog](https://ladestack.in/blog): 27 in-depth technical tutorials covering AI systems, RAG architecture, MLOps, and SaaS scalability
- [About](https://ladestack.in/about): Founder story, engineering principles, and technical philosophy of Girish Lade
- [Support Center](https://ladestack.in/support): Developer FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and client-side help desk
- [Contact](https://ladestack.in/contact): Direct engineering team feedback, bug reports, and technical collaboration
- [Privacy Policy](https://ladestack.in/privacy): In-browser data safety, client-side processing, and zero-retention policy
- [Terms of Service](https://ladestack.in/terms): Perpetual free-use license for personal and commercial development

## Web Applications & Utilities
- [CodeEnhance AI](https://ladestack.in/ai-code-viewer-ai): In-browser HTML/CSS/JS optimizer and live code sandbox
- [LS PDF Tools](https://pdf.ladestack.in/): Client-side PDF merge, split, compress, and conversion utilities
- [LS Image Studio](https://img.ladestack.in/): In-browser batch image compression and format converter
- [Swift Resume](https://resume.ladestack.in/): ATS-friendly developer resume builder with live PDF preview
- [Bharat Land Records](https://land.ladestack.in/): Clean, high-speed land record lookup utility for India
